reviewType: independent source and isolated Astro-render audit
snapshot: Current shared uncommitted source; hashes below identify reviewed inputs. No rebuilt/production visual claim.

verdict.goal: active; broader route coverage remains incomplete

findings.scope: Application confirmation correctness; not a claim of unauthorized backend mutation
findings.title: GET query string alone claims an application was saved
findings.reproduction: With a successful empty participation read and no signed-in user, ?submitted=1 sets submitted=true. Actual Apply Astro render with those props contains both 'Application saved' and 'Applications are closed' and no form; zero submission/network calls.
findings.correction: Remove the query-derived success assertion; show authoritative card.applied state, or a one-time server-confirmed result tied to the successful POST. A reloadable URL is not proof of mutation.
findings.falsification: Forged submitted=1, anonymous GET, and empty participation never claim success; successful mocked registration redirects to truthful confirmed participation feedback.

findings.title: Show directory, RSS and chapter paths do not share published-video eligibility
findings.currentImpact: All 249 current show-tagged videos are in the past, so current visible counts agree. A future recorded or live episode would count on the directory and enter RSS/chapters while the show detail excludes it.
findings.reproduction: Executed actual directory declarations with old/recent/future fixtures: all three count in cards and JSON-LD. Feed/chapter filters check show membership only.
findings.correction: Reuse the published-video predicate for archive counts/previews, RSS and chapter generation/lookup. If scheduled shows should be discoverable, separate labeled Upcoming entries from available episode totals rather than silently counting them.
findings.falsification: Future fixture excluded consistently from available counts, metadata, RSS and chapter routes; current counts remain 4/24/46/175.

findings.title: Finished or registration-closed bracket cards still advertise Apply or manage entry
findings.reproduction: Actual Seasons render for a finished historical bracket emits /shows/klustered/apply and 'Apply or manage entry'. The participation loader only returns openBrackets, so that route cannot manage the selected finished bracket.
findings.correction: Link historical/closed brackets to a bracket-results destination (add a stable board anchor if needed); only show an application CTA for an eligible open bracket. Do not infer that published historical shows have open registration.
findings.falsification: Finished and expired fixtures offer results/archive navigation, not an application promise; eligible open fixtures retain the apply destination.

findings.title: Schedule mixes historical/upcoming matches with yearless, timezone-less server-local dates
findings.reproduction: Actual Schedule render of 2021-04-01T16:00Z completed and 2027-04-01T16:00Z scheduled fixtures prints the same date/time 'Thu 1 Apr, 17:00' in this process timezone. No <time> elements. Completed rows sort before future ones.
findings.correction: Use an explicit timezone with a visible zone and year, expose datetime on time elements, and distinguish upcoming from completed results. Preserve genuine status values; do not infer Live from old type metadata.
findings.falsification: Cross-year fixtures have distinct year-bearing labels; output is timezone-explicit and stable across server TZ; upcoming entries and historical outcomes are clearly separated.

findings.title: Unpublished show guard is missing from extension pages and API dispatch
findings.currentImpact: All four local shows are publish:true. If Klustered is unpublished, its detail returns 404 but registered extras still load; extension API routing also lacks this publication check.
findings.correction: Apply the same existence/publish gate before page loader and endpoint dispatch where publication is intended to control public access. This supplements, not replaces, POST authentication/authorization.
findings.falsification: Mock publish:false makes directory omit the show and detail/extras reject before service calls; authenticated write eligibility remains enforced independently.

findings.title: Archive preview depends on unsorted collection order
findings.reproduction: Permuting identical old/recent/future fixtures changes episodes[0] and therefore card description/thumbnail. The detail page and reusable ShowCard independently sort newest first.
findings.correction: After eligibility filtering, explicitly sort previews newest-first, or use a clearly authored show summary instead of an arbitrary episode title. Retain real cover artwork when available.
findings.falsification: Shuffling collection input cannot change the selected published preview; the archive and detail agree on latest eligible episode.

findings.title: Show archive card headings skip H2
findings.correction: Allow H2 card titles on the show archive or supply an appropriate visible H2 for the group. Do not add a redundant heading merely to preserve hard-coded H3s.
findings.falsification: Rendered outline has one Shows H1 with no H1-to-H3 jump; other card consumers retain their appropriate heading depth.

presentationFollowups.finding: doc.section wraps the default card NewsletterCTA, whose own root adds paddingBlock12; unlike the learning-path same-element fix, these are nested vertical spacing layers.
presentationFollowups.recommendation: Main visual reviewer can flatten duplicated outer spacing while preserving shell width; not a measured viewport defect.

presentationFollowups.finding: Visible episode count is repeated in hero and 'Watch all N episodes' intro; latest episode is represented in hero and first grid row on shows without covers.
presentationFollowups.recommendation: Keep a useful latest-episode shortcut, remove generic duplicated count prose if it adds height without navigation value.

presentationFollowups.finding: Unreferenced .shows-page* CSS remains after Academy migration; no current template class uses it.
presentationFollowups.recommendation: Remove only obsolete local style block in a separately authorized cleanup.

presentationFollowups.finding: Empty show says 'coming soon' without a schedule; existing populated shows are unaffected.
presentationFollowups.recommendation: Prefer 'No published episodes are available' rather than promising future production.

presentationFollowups.finding: Apply/Seasons/Schedule use legacy utilities, while BracketBoard and shared shell use Academy recipes. Relevant utility definitions exist in global.css; this audit does not label them all unsupported.
presentationFollowups.recommendation: Migrate bounded components when editing them; do not restore a broad utility shim or claim unmeasured contrast failures.
